items.gtk_lead: Mapagkakatiwalaan ba ang Biblia?
items.gtk_principle: Alam ng Diyos ang wakas mula pa sa pasimula. Ang nakikilala mo sa kasaysayan ng mga kaharian ay nagbibigay ng dahilan upang magtiwala sa Kanyang pangako tungkol sa kahariang darating pa.

gtk_connections.title: Isang pahayag na nararapat subukin
gtk_connections.insight: Inilalarawan ni Pedro ang mga taong nagsalita sa patnubay ng Banal na Espiritu. Nagbibigay si Daniel ng isang tiyak na mensaheng maaari mong suriin. Mababasa mo ang sinabi niya sa hari at matitimbang ang paliwanag sa iyong sarili.

gtk_connections.title: Ang Diyos na nagmamahal nang walang pag-iimbot
gtk_connections.insight: Sinabi ni Juan na minahal ng Diyos ang mundo at ibinigay ang Kanyang Anak. Tandaan ang larawang ito ng Diyos habang binabasa mo ang tungkol sa Kanyang kapangyarihan sa mga hari. Ano ang kahulugan ng pagkakaroon ng huling salita sa kasaysayan ng Siyang nagmahal sa iyo nang sapat upang ibigay ang Kanyang Anak?

gtk_connections.title: Ang haring tumanggap ng isang kaharian
gtk_connections.insight: Pakinggan ang mga salitang pinili ni Daniel. Sinabi niya kay Nabucodonosor na ang Diyos ng langit ang nagbigay sa kanya ng kaharian. Nangailangan ng tapang ang isang bihag upang sabihin iyon sa pinunong lumupig sa kanyang bayan. Hindi kailanman nailayo si Daniel sa abot ng Diyos dahil sa tagumpay ng Babilonia.

gtk_questions.question: May pag-aalinlangan ako. Ibig bang sabihin nito ay kulang ang pananampalataya ko?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Ang isang pinag-isipang tanong ay maaaring simula ng tapat na pananampalataya. Basahin ang talata ayon sa konteksto, itanong kung ano talaga ang sinasabi nito, at suriin ang ebidensiya sa halip na magkunwaring tiyak ka.

gtk_questions.question: Sinasabi ba ng panaginip kung aling makabagong bansa ang kinakatawan ng bawat daliri sa paa?
gtk_questions.answer: Ipinaliwanag ni Daniel na ang bakal at putik ay isang nahating kaharian, na bahaging malakas at bahaging marupok. Hindi siya nagbigay ng listahang nagtutugma sa bawat daliri sa paa at isang bansa. Sapat ang kanyang paliwanag upang masundan mo ang panaginip hanggang sa katapusan nito.

gtk_questions.question: Anong pag-asa ang nasa batong dumudurog sa rebulto?
gtk_questions.answer: Para sa isang taong nabubuhay sa ilalim ng malupit na pinuno, maaaring magandang balita ang pagtatapos ng kapangyarihan ng pinunong iyon. Ipinakikita ng bato na hahatulan ng Diyos ang mga kapangyarihan sa lupa at tatapusin ang kanilang pamamahala. Nangangako ang Daniel 2:44 ng kahariang hindi kailanman magigiba.

items.gtk_lead: Kung mapagmahal ang Diyos, bakit may kasamaan?
items.gtk_principle: Hindi maaaring ipilit ang pag-ibig. Inilalarawan ng Kasulatan ang kasamaan bilang tunay na kaaway ng mabuting nilikha ng Diyos, hindi bilang bahagi ng orihinal Niyang layunin. Ipinakikita ni Hesus ang sagot ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ng pag-ibig na nagsasakripisyo para sa iba at ng pangakong magwawakas ang kasamaan.

gtk_connections.title: Ang mabuting paglalang at pagpasok ng kasamaan
gtk_connections.insight: Likas na itanong: kung mapagmahal at makapangyarihan ang Diyos, bakit napakaraming pagdurusa sa mundo? Nagsisimula ang Genesis sa paglalarawang napakabuti ng paglalang. Sa talinghaga ni Hesus tungkol sa trigo at mga damo, isang kaaway ang nagpasok ng mapanirang bagay sa bukiring nahasikan ng mabuting binhi. Hindi ipinaliliwanag ng Biblia ang bawat trahedya o binibigyang-katwiran ang maling gawa, ngunit hinihiling nitong huwag nating ipagkamali ang orihinal na layunin ng Diyos sa pinsalang dulot ng paghihimagsik at kasalanan. Hindi inilalarawang nalulugod ang Diyos sa pagdurusa.

gtk_connections.title: Ginagawang posible ng kalayaan ang pag-ibig
gtk_connections.insight: Ang katapatang nakukuha sa pamimilit ay panlabas na pagsunod, hindi tunay na pag-ibig. Makikita sa buong pag-aaral na ito ang pagkakaiba ng pagtataas sa sarili at ng pagpapakumbaba ni Hesus. Inilalarawan ng Kasulatan ang kaaway na nagnanais ng katayuang para sa Diyos, samantalang pinili ni Cristo na maglingkod at ibigay ang Kanyang sarili. Ang tanong ay hindi lamang kung sino ang mas makapangyarihan, kundi kung kaninong karakter ang mapagkakatiwalaan. Kasama sa kalayaan ang posibilidad ng maling pagpili, at maaaring makapinsala sa iba ang gayong mga pagpili.

gtk_connections.title: Sinasagot ng krus ang mga paratang
gtk_connections.insight: Maaaring ipagtanggol ng isang taong inaakusahan ng pagkamakasarili ang sarili sa pamamagitan ng mga salita. Sinasagot ni Hesus ang pinakamalalalim na paratang laban sa Diyos sa pamamagitan ng Kanyang ginagawa. Ang Siyang may buong karapatang paglingkuran ay pumasok sa ating sirang mundo at nagbigay ng Kanyang buhay para sa mga tumalikod sa Kanya. Hindi ibig sabihin nito na nalutas na ang bawat hiwaga tungkol sa pagdurusa. Ibig sabihin nito, ang krus ang nagbibigay sa atin ng pinakamalinaw na katibayan na handang magdusa ang Diyos para sa Kanyang nilikha sa halip na talikuran ito.

gtk_questions.question: Nilikha ba ng Diyos si Satanas na masama?
gtk_questions.answer: Itinuturo ng pag-aaral na nilikha ng Diyos ang isang mabuting anghel na may kalayaan, hindi isang diyablong itinakdang gumawa ng mali. Inilalarawan ng Kasulatan ang paghihimagsik ngunit hindi nito ipinaliliwanag ang pinakahuling dahilan ng kasalanan.

gtk_questions.question: Bakit hindi agad pinipigilan ng Diyos ang bawat trahedya?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi nagbibigay ang Biblia ng isang simpleng paliwanag sa sakit ng bawat tao. Sinasabi nitong laban ang Diyos sa kasamaan, iginagalang Niya ang kalayaan, at ipinangangako Niya ang panghuling pagwawakas ng pagdurusa. Dapat tayong tumugon sa pagdurusa nang may habag, hindi paninisi.

gtk_questions.question: Ibig bang sabihin ng pagdurusa ay pinarurusahan ako ng Diyos?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi kinakailangan. Hindi natin dapat ipalagay na ang paghihirap ng isang tao ay tuwirang parusa sa kanyang personal na kasalanan. Pinakitunguhan ni Hesus nang may habag ang mga nagdurusa.

items.teacher_title: Ang Gawain ng Banal na Espiritu
items.gtk_title: Ang Gawain ng Banal na Espiritu
items.gtk_lead: Paano binabago ng Diyos ang isang tao mula sa loob?
items.gtk_principle: Tinutulungan tayo ng Espiritu na tumugon kay Hesus, tinitiyak na tayo ay kabilang sa Diyos, at hinuhubog sa atin ang pag-ibig na hindi kayang likhain ng kautusan lamang.

gtk_connections.title: Ang paghatol sa kasalanan ay nilalayong maghatid sa pagtitiwala
gtk_connections.insight: Maaaring maging simula ang pagkabahala sa isang maling gawa, ngunit hindi kayang baguhin ng pagkakasala lamang ang isang tao. Sinabi ni Hesus na ihahayag ng Espiritu ang kasalanan at aakayin ang mga tao sa katotohanan. Ang gawain ng Espiritu ay hindi ang durugin ang isang tao sa kawalan ng pag-asa, kundi dalhin siya sa Tagapagligtas na kayang magpatawad at magbago. Kung ang pagkakonsensiya ay nagpaalala sa iyo ng isang sirang relasyon o nakatagong panlilinlang, tumugon sa pamamagitan ng paglapit kay Hesus, tapat na pag-amin, at paggawa ng kasunod na hakbang ng pananampalataya.

gtk_connections.title: Ang pagiging kabilang ay nauuna sa espirituwal na pagkahinog
gtk_connections.insight: Inilalarawan ni Pablo ang mga taong nakarinig ng mabuting balita, nanampalataya, at tumanggap ng Banal na Espiritu bilang tatak ng pangako ng Diyos. Maaaring nahihirapan pa rin ang bagong mananampalataya sa mga nakasanayan, pag-aalinlangan, at damdamin. Hindi itinuturo ng mga talatang ito na kailangan muna tayong maging sakdal bago tayo tanggapin ng Diyos. Itinuturo nilang tinatanggap tayo ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ni Cristo at sinisimulan Niyang gumawa sa atin. Isipin ang isang batang natututo sa mga kaugalian ng pamilya dahil kabilang na siya rito, sa halip na nagsisikap munang makamit ang karapatang maging anak.

gtk_connections.title: Binabago ng bagong tipan ang panloob na buhay
gtk_connections.insight: Ang pangako ng Diyos ay hindi lamang panibagong hanay ng mga panlabas na tuntunin. Nag-aalok Siya ng kapatawaran at isinusulat ang Kanyang kalooban sa puso at isipan. Ang parehong mga prinsipyong moral na naghahayag ng pagkamakasarili ay nagiging bagay na ninanais natin habang tinuturuan tayo ng Espiritu na umibig. Pinangangalagaan nito ang dalawang mahalagang katotohanan: hindi tayo naliligtas sa pagsunod sa mga tuntunin, at hindi tayo iniiwan ng biyaya na walang pagbabago. Kapag nagbago ang puso, ang pagsunod ay nagiging mapagpasalamat na tugon sa pag-ibig ng Diyos, hindi pagtatangkang bilhin iyon.

gtk_questions.question: Nagkakamali pa rin ako. Wala ba sa akin ang Espiritu?
gtk_questions.answer: Ang espirituwal na paglago ay isang paglalakbay. Tapat na ilapit sa Diyos ang iyong mga pagkabigo, magsisi kung kailangan, at hingin ang Kanyang tulong upang lumago. Hindi katumbas ng biglaang kasakdalan ang pag-unlad.

gtk_questions.question: Paano ko makikilala ang paggabay ng Espiritu?
gtk_questions.answer: Ihambing ang iyong mga impresyon sa Kasulatan at sa karakter ni Hesus. Humingi ng payo sa mga taong may karunungan. Hindi tayo hinihiling ng Espiritu na talikuran ang katotohanan, kabaitan, o katapatan.

gtk_questions.question: Kailangan ko ba ng isang pambihirang karanasang espirituwal?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi lahat ay nakararanas nito. Ang tahimik na pagbabago sa pagtitiwala, pag-ibig, at pagsunod ay maaari ring tunay na katibayan ng gawain ng Diyos.

items.gtk_lead: Ano ang itinuturo ng sinaunang santuwaryo tungkol kay Hesus?
items.gtk_principle: Isinasalaysay ng santuwaryo kung paano pinakikitunguhan ng Diyos ang kasalanan upang maibalik ang pakikisama sa Kanya. Ang bawat bahagi ng paglilingkod ay nagtuturo sa kabila ng sarili nito, patungo kay Hesus.

gtk_connections.title: Ang tunay na suliranin ay pagkakahiwalay
gtk_connections.insight: Matapos sumuway sina Adan at Eva, nagtago sila. Hinanap sila ng Diyos. Ipinakikita ng kanilang takot at kahihiyan kung paano sinisira ng kasalanan ang pagtitiwala at relasyon. Dito nagsisimula ang mensahe ng santuwaryo: paano muling mamumuhay sa presensiya ng Diyos ang mga taong tumalikod sa Kanya? Ang sagot ng Diyos ay hindi ang talikuran ang pamilya ng sangkatauhan. Nagbigay Siya ng nakikitang sistema ng pagtuturo upang ipakitang seryoso ang kasalanan, maaaring tumanggap ng awa, at maaaring maibalik ang pakikisama sa Kanya. Kuwento ito ng relasyon, hindi lamang ng mga sinaunang kagamitan sa pagsamba.

gtk_connections.title: Ipinakikita ng mga simbolo ang halaga ng pagliligtas
gtk_connections.insight: Inutusan ng Diyos ang Israel na gumawa ng santuwaryo upang makapanahan Siya sa gitna nila. Itinuro ng mga hain na may halaga ang maling gawa at sentro ng pagkakasundo ang walang-salang Kahalili. Walang sariling kapangyarihang magligtas ang paulit-ulit na pag-aalay ng mga hayop. Itinuro ng mga iyon ang darating na si Hesus, na kusang ibinigay ang Kanyang sarili minsan para sa lahat. Pinangangalagaan ng pagkaunawang ito laban sa maling palagay na sa sinaunang panahon ay naliligtas ang tao sa pamamagitan ng mga hayop, ngunit ngayon lamang sa biyaya. Ang plano ng Diyos sa pagliligtas ay palaging nakasalalay kay Cristo.

gtk_connections.title: Ang bawat bahagi ay nagtuturo kay Hesus
gtk_connections.insight: Itinuturo ng kordero ang ating pansin sa sakripisyo ni Hesus. Ipinahihiwatig ng paghuhugas sa hugasan ang paglilinis at bagong buhay. Ipinapaalala ng tinapay na pinatitibay tayo ni Cristo; ng ilaw na ginagabayan Niya tayo; at ng insenso na maaari nating maunawaan ang panalangin at pamamagitan. Nasa loob ng kaban ang mga utos, na nagpapakitang hindi ibig sabihin ng kapatawaran ay wala nang pagpapahalaga ang Diyos sa katuwiran. Mga larawang panturo ang mga ugnayang ito, hindi hiwalay na pinagmumulan ng awtoridad. Ipinaliliwanag ng Kasulatan ang kahulugan ng mga ito at pinananatili si Hesus sa sentro.

gtk_questions.question: Bakit naghahain ng mga hayop ang mga tao?
gtk_questions.answer: Gumamit ang sistema ng santuwaryo ng mga nakikitang simbolo upang ituro ang bigat ng kasalanan at ang plano ng Diyos na magligtas. Sinasabi ng Hebreo na ang paulit-ulit na mga hain ay mga aninong nagtuturo sa darating na si Cristo.

gtk_questions.question: Kailangan ko ba ng pari upang makalapit sa Diyos ngayon?
gtk_questions.answer: Si Hesus ang ating Tagapagligtas at Dakilang Saserdote sa langit. Lumalapit tayo sa Diyos sa pamamagitan ng pananampalataya sa Kanya.

gtk_questions.question: Ang santuwaryo ba ay sinaunang kasaysayan lamang?
gtk_questions.answer: Inilalarawan nito ang kaligtasan at ang patuloy na ministeryo ni Hesus, na pinananatiling sentro ang Kanyang biyaya at pag-ibig.

items.gtk_lead: Paano ako mapapatawad at makapagsisimulang muli?
items.gtk_principle: Naliligtas tayo sa biyaya ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ng pananampalataya kay Hesus, hindi dahil sa ating mga nagawang panrelihiyon. Ang biyaya ring nagpapatawad sa atin ang nagsisimulang magbago sa paraan ng ating pamumuhay.

gtk_connections.title: Ang unang sugat ay ang nasirang pagkakilala sa Diyos
gtk_connections.insight: Bago kinain nina Adan at Eva ang bunga, nagtanim muna ang ahas ng pag-aalinlangan sa salita at kabutihan ng Diyos. Mula sa pagtitiwala, napunta sila sa takot, pagtatago, at paninisi. Nakikita natin ang gayunding huwaran kapag nagdududa tayong ninanais ng Diyos ang ating kabutihan, nagsisikap na bigyang-katwiran ang sarili, o sinisisi ang iba sa ating mga pasiya. Kaya ang kaligtasan ay higit pa sa pagpapawalang-bisa ng kaparusahan. Kailangang ibalik ng Diyos ang ating pagtitiwala, pagalingin ang makasariling kalooban, at akayin tayong muli sa mapagmahal na pakikipag-ugnayan sa Kaniya.

gtk_connections.title: Ang Diyos ang unang kumikilos
gtk_connections.insight: Hindi natin kailangang hikayatin ang isang Diyos na ayaw magmahal upang mahalin tayo. Sinasabi ng Kasulatan na inibig ng Diyos ang sanlibutan at isinugo ang Kaniyang Anak noong tayo ay mga makasalanan pa. Hindi namatay si Hesus upang gawing maawain ang Ama; inihahayag ng Kaniyang kamatayan ang pag-ibig ng Ama. Mahalaga ang pagkakaibang ito sa taong lumaking natatakot na naghahanap lamang ang Diyos ng dahilan upang siya ay itakwil. Ang biyaya ay nangangahulugang lumalapit ang Diyos upang tugunan ang pangangailangang hindi natin kailanman matutugunan sa sariling pagsisikap.

gtk_connections.title: Magkaugnay ang kapatawaran at bagong buhay
gtk_connections.insight: Binabanggit ng Biblia ang pakikipagkasundo—ang dating magkaaway ay nagiging magkaibigan—at ang pagiging bagong nilalang kay Cristo. Tinutugunan ng kamatayan ni Hesus ang ating pagkakasala at pagkakahiwalay; ang Kaniyang muling nabuhay na buhay ang saligan ng ating pag-asa at patuloy na pagbabago. Ang pagtanggap sa kaligtasan ay hindi pagkukunwaring walang kabuluhan ang kasamaan. Ito ay pagtanggap sa tugon ng Diyos dito, pagtalikod sa kasalanan, at pamumuhay sa panibagong pakikipag-ugnayan sa Kaniya. Ang mabubuting gawa ay bunga ng bagong buhay, hindi ang halagang ibinabayad natin upang matamo ito.

gtk_questions.question: May mga nagawa akong pinagsisisihan. Mapapatawad ba talaga ako ng Diyos?
gtk_questions.answer: Oo. Ang paanyaya ng ebanghelyo ay para sa mga makasalanang lumalapit sa Diyos nang may pagtitiwala at pagsisisi. Ang kapatawaran ay hindi pagkukunwaring walang nagawang pinsala; kung maaari, sinisikap din nating ituwid ang ating pagkakamali.

gtk_questions.question: Kailangan ko bang maging mabuti muna bago lumapit kay Hesus?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Lumapit ka sa kalagayan mo ngayon. Sa pagtanggap kay Cristo, nagsisimula ang prosesong binabago Niya tayo.

gtk_questions.question: Bakit mahalaga pa ang mga utos kung libre ang kaligtasan?
gtk_questions.answer: Dahil binabago ng pag-ibig ang pakikitungo natin sa Diyos at sa kapwa. Ang pagsunod ay lumalago mula sa pagtitiwala at pasasalamat; hindi nito mabibili ang kaligtasan.

items.gtk_lead: Ang mga utos ba ng Diyos ay tungkol lamang sa mga tuntunin, o tungkol sa pag-ibig?
items.gtk_principle: Ipinakikita ng kautusan ng Diyos ang anyo ng pag-ibig at kalayaan. Hindi tayo nito kayang iligtas, ngunit isinusulat ng Espiritu ang mga simulain nito sa puso ng mga iniligtas ni Cristo.

gtk_connections.title: Ang pag-ibig ang nagbibigay-kahulugan sa mga utos
gtk_connections.insight: Binuod ni Hesus ang kautusan bilang pag-ibig sa Diyos at sa kapwa. Hindi nito ibig sabihing papalitan ng damdaming mapagmahal ang malinaw na patnubay sa mabuting asal. Sa halip, ipinakikita ng mga utos ang pag-ibig sa gawa: ang pagsasalita ng katotohanan, katapatan, paggalang sa buhay, pagpaparangal sa pamilya, at pag-iwas sa kasakiman ay nangangalaga sa mga ugnayan. Ang tuntuning sinusunod nang walang pag-ibig ay maaaring maging malamig at mapagmataas; ang pag-ibig na walang malasakit sa kapakanan ng iba ay maaaring maging hungkag na pananalita. Pinag-uugnay ni Hesus ang dalawa.

gtk_connections.title: Nauna ang pagliligtas bago ang mga utos
gtk_connections.insight: Bago ibinigay ng Diyos ang Sampung Utos, ipinaalala Niya sa Israel na inilabas Niya sila sa pagkaalipin. Mahalaga ang pagkakasunod-sunod na ito. Hindi Niya sinabing kailangan muna silang sumunod nang ganap bago Niya isaalang-alang ang pagpapalaya sa kanila. Iniligtas muna Niya sila, saka itinuro kung paano mamuhay ang mga taong malaya. Ibinubunyag ng kautusan ang kasalanan at ipinapaliwanag ang kalooban ng Diyos, ngunit hindi nito mahuhugasan ang kasalanan o mabibigyan ng kapangyarihang baguhin ang puso. Ang kaligtasan ay kaloob ng Diyos; ang pagsunod ang nararapat na pagtugon.

gtk_connections.title: Isang kautusan ng kalayaan
gtk_connections.insight: Iniisip minsan ng tao na ang lahat ng hangganan ay kaaway ng kalayaan. Ngunit sa isang mundong walang katotohanan, katapatan, o pagtupad sa pangako, mas mababawasan ang kaligtasan at kalayaan ng bawat isa. Tulad ng pag-aaral tumugtog ng instrumento, ang disiplina ay maaaring magbukas ng mga pagkakataong sinisira ng kawalang-ingat. Tinatawag ni Santiago ang tagubilin ng Diyos na kautusan ng kalayaan sapagkat inilalayo tayo nito sa mga kaugaliang umaalipin. Ang tanong ay hindi lamang, “Ano ang pinapayagan kong gawin?” kundi “Anong uri ng tao ang itinuturo ng pag-ibig na maging ako?”

gtk_questions.question: Ginagawa ba akong karapat-dapat sa kaligtasan ng pagtupad sa mga utos?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Ang kaligtasan ay kaloob sa pamamagitan ni Cristo. Ang pagsunod sa mga utos ng Diyos ay tugon sa biyaya, hindi paraan upang bilhin ito.

gtk_questions.question: Paano kung parang naghihigpit sa akin ang pagsunod sa Diyos?
gtk_questions.answer: Itanong kung ano ang pinangangalagaan ng bawat utos: pagtitiwala, kapahingahan, pamilya, buhay, katotohanan, o pagkakontento. Gaya ng mabubuting hangganan sa mga relasyon, ginagawang mas ligtas ng mapagmahal na mga simulain ang kalayaan.

gtk_questions.question: Magkasalungat ba ang kabaitan at pagsunod?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Ipinakita ni Hesus na ang tunay na pagsunod ay hinuhubog ng awa, katotohanan, at pag-ibig.

items.gtk_practice: Basahin ang Exodo 20. Sa bawat utos, isulat ang mabuting ugnayang pinangangalagaan nito. Pagkatapos, pagnilayan kung paano binabago ng biyaya ang dahilan ng iyong pagsunod.

items.gtk_lead: Paano maililihis ng huwad na relihiyon ang pansin mula kay Hesus?
items.gtk_principle: Si Hesus lamang ang nagliligtas at karapat-dapat sa ating pinakamataas na katapatan. Nagbababala ang propesiya na maaaring gayahin ng kapangyarihang panrelihiyon ang Kaniyang awtoridad at ilihis ang pagsamba palayo sa Kaniya.

gtk_connections.title: Magsimula sa malinaw na mga talata
gtk_connections.insight: Nagbabala si Juan na maraming anticristo at itinuon niya ang pansin sa itinuturo ng mga tao tungkol kay Hesus. Nagsisimula ang usapin sa katotohanan tungkol kay Cristo, hindi sa haka-haka tungkol sa isang di-kilalang kontrabida sa hinaharap. Maaaring gumamit ang isang tao ng mga salitang Kristiyano ngunit ilihis ang pagtitiwala mula sa tunay na Tagapagligtas. Bago pag-aralan ang mga sagisag ng propesiya, matutuhang itanong ang pangunahing tanong: inaakay ba ng turong ito ang mga tao sa Hesus na ipinakikilala ng Kasulatan, o inilalagay nito ang ibang awtoridad sa lugar na sa Kaniya lamang nararapat?

gtk_connections.title: Ang panganib ng kapangyarihang panrelihiyon
gtk_connections.insight: Inilalarawan ng mga talatang ito ang paghihimagsik na nababalutan ng mga pag-aangking panrelihiyon at isang kapangyarihang sumasalungat sa Diyos. Sinusundan ng pag-aaral ang magkakasunod na kaharian sa Daniel bago talakayin ang sumunod na kapangyarihang panrelihiyon at pampolitika. Sa ganitong pag-unawa, ang mga sagisag ay tumutukoy sa mga sistema at pag-aangkin ng awtoridad, hindi sa paghatol sa puso ng bawat taong kaugnay ng isang institusyon. Diyos lamang ang nakaaalam sa bawat tao. Maaari nating tutulan ang mga maling pag-aangkin at pamimilit sa relihiyon habang pinakikitunguhan nang may dignidad at pag-ibig ang mga tao sa lahat ng pananampalataya.

gtk_connections.title: Hindi maaaring ipilit ang pagsamba
gtk_connections.insight: Inihahambing ng Apocalipsis ang kapangyarihang namimilit sa panawagan ng Diyos na sambahin ang Manlilikha. Maaaring makalikha ng panlabas na pagsunod ang sapilitang relihiyon, ngunit hindi ito makalilikha ng pag-ibig. Pinag-uugnay nito ang mga naunang aralin tungkol sa tunggalian ng mabuti at masama, ebanghelyo, kautusan, at bagong tipan. Ang taong nakakakilala kay Hesus at nagpapahalaga sa kalayaan ng budhi ay inihahandang piliin Siya kahit hindi iyon popular.

gtk_questions.question: Kaaway ba ang mga Katoliko?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Ang ating kapwa ay mga taong nararapat igalang at mahalin. Sinusuri ng pag-aaral na ito ang makasaysayang mga estruktura at pag-aangkin ng awtoridad; hindi ito dapat gamitin upang hatulan ang mga indibidwal o ang katapatan ng kanilang pananampalataya.

gtk_questions.question: Bakit magkakaiba ang pagkaunawa ng mga Kristiyano sa mga propesiyang ito?
gtk_questions.answer: Magkakaiba ang ginagamit nilang paraan ng pagpapakahulugan. Sundan ang mga sagisag ng Daniel ayon sa konteksto at suriin ang mga makasaysayang pagtukoy gamit ang mapagkakatiwalaang katibayan.

gtk_questions.question: Paano ako makaiiwas sa panlilinlang?
gtk_questions.answer: Ituon ang pansin kay Hesus, basahin ang Kasulatan ayon sa konteksto, at huwag magpadala sa sinumang humihingi ng walang-pasubaling katapatang panrelihiyon.

items.gtk_practice: Gumawa ng dalawang hanay: “ang karakter ni Cristo” at “mga pag-aangkin ng huwad na awtoridad”. Maglagay ng isang talata sa Biblia sa tabi ng bawat entry at manalangin para sa katapatan at pag-ibig.

items.gtk_lead: Ano ang ipinahihiwatig ng takdang panahon sa Daniel tungkol kay Hesus?
items.gtk_principle: Nagbibigay ang Daniel 9 ng isang takdang panahon sa propesiya na nakatuon sa Mesiyas. Mahalaga ito sapagkat ang ministeryo at sakripisyo ni Hesus ang sentro ng mga pangako ng Diyos.

gtk_connections.title: Ang konteksto ay isang panalangin para sa pagpapanumbalik
gtk_connections.insight: Hindi nagsimula si Daniel sa pagtatangkang lumutas ng palaisipan. Ipinahayag niya ang kasalanan, inalala ang awa ng Diyos, at nanalangin para sa pagpapanumbalik ng Jerusalem. Dumating ang paliwanag ng anghel sa konteksto ng katapatan ng Diyos sa Kaniyang tipan. Sa ganitong pagbasa, ang mga petsa ay hindi nagiging hiwalay na pagsasanay lamang sa pagkukuwenta. Ang layunin ng propesiya ay ang gawain ng Diyos sa pakikipagkasundo at ang pagdating ng Mesiyas, hindi ang kasabikang magkuwenta ng mga numero.

gtk_connections.title: Bakit itinuturing na mga taon ang pitumpung linggo
gtk_connections.insight: Ang pitumpung linggo ay may 490 araw. Ginagamit ng pag-aaral ang simulaing isang araw para sa isang taon sa propesiya upang unawain ang panahong ito bilang 490 taon. Isa itong hakbang sa pagpapakahulugan na dapat ipaliwanag, hindi basta ipalagay: ipinakikita ng mga halimbawa sa Mga Bilang at Ezekiel kung paano maaaring kumatawan ang isang araw sa isang taon sa konteksto ng propesiya. Pagkatapos tukuyin ang ipinapanukalang panimulang utos, maaaring sundan ng mambabasa ang pangangatwiran at suriin kung naaayon sa ministeryo ni Hesus ang resulta ng takdang panahon.

gtk_connections.title: Ang sentro ay ang Mesiyas
gtk_connections.insight: Nagsisimula ang balangkas sa utos na may kaugnayan sa pagpapanumbalik noong 457 BC, sumusulong patungo sa pagpapahid kay Hesus noong AD 27, at inilalagay ang Kaniyang kamatayan sa kalagitnaan ng huling linggo ng propesiya. Ang balangkas na ito ay nakasalig sa makasaysayang pagtukoy at sa pagbasa ng isang araw bilang isang taon, hindi sa isang talatang tuwirang nagtatala ng lahat ng makabagong petsang iyon. Ang kahanga-hanga sa aralin ay ang papel ni Cristo: dumarating ang ipinangakong Hari upang magligtas sa pamamagitan ng sakripisyo, hindi lamang upang agawin ang isang trono.

gtk_questions.question: Kailangan ko bang maunawaan ang lahat ng numero upang sumunod kay Hesus?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Unawain muna ang pangunahing mensahe: tinutupad ng Diyos ang Kaniyang mga pangako, at si Hesus ang ipinangakong Tagapagligtas. Maaari mong pag-aralan ang takdang panahon nang paisa-isang hakbang.

gtk_questions.question: Nagkakaisa ba ang lahat ng Kristiyano sa mga petsa?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Magkakaiba ang pagkaunawa ng mga Kristiyano sa Daniel 9 at sa ilang makasaysayang petsa. Ihambing ang mga talata, ang panimulang utos, at ang pangangatwirang isang araw para sa isang taon bago magpasya kung ano ang kahulugan ng takdang panahon.

gtk_questions.question: Ano ang pinakamahalagang bahagi ng propesiya?
gtk_questions.answer: Ang pagtutok nito sa Mesiyas at ang kahulugan ng Kaniyang kamatayan—hindi ang pagkapanalo sa pagtatalo tungkol sa mga numero.

items.gtk_practice: Gumuhit ng takdang panahon na may mga tandang 457 BC, AD 27, AD 31, at AD 34. Sa tabi ng bawat isa, isulat ang kaugnay na pangyayari at isang talata sa Biblia na sumusuporta rito.

items.gtk_lead: Talaga bang nabuhay si Hesus bilang isang tao sa kasaysayan?
items.gtk_principle: Nakaugat ang pananampalatayang Kristiyano sa mga pahayag tungkol sa tunay na mga tao, pangyayari, at saksi. Dapat maingat na siyasatin ang katibayan, hindi palakihin ang sinasabi nito.

gtk_connections.title: May mga makasaysayang pahayag ang pananampalatayang Kristiyano
gtk_connections.insight: Inilalagay ng mga manunulat ng Ebanghelyo si Hesus sa gitna ng mga tunay na tao at pinuno, at ipinahayag ng mga unang Kristiyano ang Kaniyang kamatayan at muling pagkabuhay bilang mga pangyayari, hindi lamang bilang sagisag ng mabuting asal. Hindi kayang patunayan ng kasaysayan ang bawat konklusyong teolohikal na hinahango ng Biblia, ngunit makatutulong ito upang suriin kung nagsimula ang kilusan sa tunay na panahon at lugar. Hindi kailangang magkaaway ang pananampalataya at maingat na pagsusuri.

gtk_connections.title: Suriin ang pinakamaagang mga patotoo
gtk_connections.insight: Nakasentro ang pangangaral ni Pedro sa ministeryo, pagpapako sa krus, at muling pagkabuhay ni Hesus. Isinulat ni Pablo na kung hindi muling nabuhay si Cristo, walang kabuluhan ang pangangaral ng mga Kristiyano. Dapat mag-udyok ng maingat na mga tanong ang mga matitibay na pahayag na ito. Ano ang sinisikap paniwalain ng mga apostol sa kanilang mga tagapakinig? Ano ang nagbago sa unang pamayanang Kristiyano? Bakit patuloy nilang ipinahayag si Cristo sa kabila ng pagsalungat? Inaanyayahan tayo ng mensaheng Kristiyano na isaalang-alang kapuwa ang katibayan at kahulugan.

gtk_connections.title: May halaga at hangganan ang mga sangguniang mula sa labas
gtk_connections.insight: Makatutulong ang mga manunulat na gaya nina Tacitus at Josephus upang maipakitang bahagi ng sinaunang kasaysayan ng Roma si Hesus at ang mga unang Kristiyano. Hindi nila pinapalitan ang mga Ebanghelyo, at ang mga sumunod na mananalaysay ay hindi nagbibigay ng salaysay na personal nilang nasaksihan para sa bawat himala. Ihiwalay ang tunay na sinasabi ng isang panlabas na sanggunian sa mga konklusyong nais nating masuportahan nito. Mas matibay ang ganitong paraan kaysa sa pag-uulit ng kahanga-hangang mga bilang tungkol sa mga manuskrito o mananalaysay nang hindi sinusuri.

gtk_questions.question: Mali bang maghanap ng katibayan?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Maaaring malugod na tanggapin ng mga Kristiyano ang tapat na pagsusuring pangkasaysayan. Dapat suriin ang isang pahayag batay sa katibayan nito, hindi ilayo sa mga tanong.

gtk_questions.question: Pinatutunayan ba ng mga Romanong mananalaysay ang muling pagkabuhay?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Sinusuportahan nila ang ilang makasaysayang katotohanan tungkol kay Hesus at sa mga unang Kristiyano. Ang pahayag tungkol sa muling pagkabuhay ay pangunahing nakasalig sa patotoo ng mga unang Kristiyano.

gtk_questions.question: Paano kung hindi pa ako handang paniwalaan ang lahat?
gtk_questions.answer: Basahin ang isang Ebanghelyo, itala ang mga pahayag na maaari mong suriin, at patuloy na magtanong nang makatarungan. Mahalaga ang maingat na proseso.

items.gtk_practice: Basahin ang 1 Corinto 15 at isang salaysay ng muling pagkabuhay sa isang Ebanghelyo. Itala ang mga pahayag ng bawat manunulat, ang katibayang ibinigay, at ang susunod na tanong na nais mong siyasatin.

items.gtk_lead: Dapat ba tayong matakot sa paghuhukom ng Diyos?
items.gtk_principle: Ibinubunyag ng paghuhukom ng Diyos ang Kaniyang katarungan at ang katotohanan tungkol sa mga pagpili ng tao. Ang mabuting balita ay si Hesus ang matuwid na Hukom at ang Tagapagtanggol ng mga nagtitiwala sa Kaniya.

gtk_connections.title: Ipinagtatanggol ng paghuhukom ang moral na kahulugan ng buhay
gtk_connections.insight: Kung ang kawalang-katarungan, pagtatago ng katotohanan, at kalupitan ay hindi kailanman mahahayag, walang magiging pangwakas na katugunan para sa mga biktima nito. Nagsasalita ang Biblia tungkol sa paghuhukom kung saan sineseryoso ng Diyos ang mga pasiya ng tao. Hindi ito dapat gawing larawan ng isang malupit na tagasulit na naghihintay lamang makakita ng pagkakamali. Pinatutunayan ng paghuhukom ng Diyos kung ano ang totoo at matuwid, inilalantad ang bunga ng mga pagpili, at ipinakikitang ang awa ay hindi kawalang-malasakit sa kasamaan.

gtk_connections.title: Ang mga aklat sa langit at ang hayagang hukuman
gtk_connections.insight: Inilalarawan ni Daniel ang isang hukuman sa langit at ang pagbubukas ng mga aklat. Ipinahihiwatig ng larawang ito na ang paghuhukom ng Diyos ay hayag, maingat, at makatarungan, hindi pabigla-bigla. Hindi nangangailangan ang Diyos ng mga aklat upang matulungan Siyang makaalala. Tinitiyak ng larawan sa buong nilalang na makatarungan ang Kaniyang mga pasiya. Sa Daniel 7, ang paghuhukom ay may kaugnayan din sa pagbibigay ng kaharian sa Anak ng Tao. Pinananatili nito ang ating pag-asang nakasentro kay Cristo sa halip na sa takot sa mga tala.

gtk_connections.title: Si Hesus ang ating kinatawan
gtk_connections.insight: Sa taong nakaaalala ng mga nagawang pagkakamali, maaaring nakatatakot pakinggan ang paghuhukom. Ngunit inilalarawan din ng Kasulatan si Hesus bilang ating Tagapagtanggol at ang Isa na namatay at muling nabuhay para sa atin. Hindi tayo humaharap sa paghuhukom na umaasa sa sarili nating malinis na tala na nakamit sa sariling lakas. Lumalapit tayo sa Diyos sa pamamagitan ni Cristo, na nagpapatawad at nagbabago sa mga nagtitiwala sa Kaniya. Hindi kailanman binibigyang-matwid ng biyaya ang sinasadyang pananakit, ngunit nagbibigay ito ng tunay na pag-asa sa mga nagsisisi.

gtk_questions.question: Gagamitin ba ang bawat lihim kong pagkakamali upang hiyain ako?
gtk_questions.answer: Seryoso ang paghuhukom ng Diyos, ngunit ipinangangako ng ebanghelyo ang kapatawaran at pagpapanumbalik kay Cristo. Ilapit ang iyong mga kasalanan sa Kaniya sa halip na mamuhay sa pagtatago at kawalan ng pag-asa.

gtk_questions.question: Kung alam ng Diyos ang lahat, bakit kailangan ang paghuhukom?
gtk_questions.answer: Ipinaliliwanag ito ng pag-aaral bilang pagpapakita ng katarungan sa buong sansinukob, hindi bilang pagtuklas ng Diyos sa impormasyong hindi Niya alam.

gtk_questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng paghuhukom sa taong nakaranas ng kawalang-katarungan?
gtk_questions.answer: Nangangahulugan itong hindi sa kasamaan ang huling salita. Nakikita ng Diyos ang hindi napapansin ng iba at ipinangangako Niya ang pangwakas na katarungan.

items.gtk_lead: Paano humahantong sa 1844 ang propesiya tungkol sa santuwaryo?
items.gtk_principle: Iniuugnay ng pag-aaral ang mahabang propesiya ni Daniel sa patuloy na ministeryo ni Hesus bilang Saserdote at sa panawagang seryosohin ang paghuhukom ng Diyos. Si Hesus pa rin ang sentro ng mensahe.

gtk_connections.title: Bahagi ng ebanghelyo ang paghuhukom
gtk_connections.insight: Binabanggit ng Bagong Tipan ang darating na paghuhukom kasabay ng pagpapahayag ng mabuting balita. Hindi kailangang ituring na magkaaway ang mga mensaheng ito. Sa huli, kailangang tugunan ng mapagmahal na Diyos ang kasamaan at ibalik ang katarungan, at si Hesus ang itinalagang humatol. Tinatalakay ng pag-aaral na ito ang takdang panahon sa propesiya bilang pagpapatuloy ng mga aralin tungkol sa kaligtasan, santuwaryo, at paghuhukom, hindi bilang hiwalay na paraan upang makamit ang pagtanggap ng Diyos.

gtk_connections.title: Itinuturo ng makalupang paglilingkod ang mga katotohanan sa langit
gtk_connections.insight: Sinunod ng santuwaryo sa ilang ang isang huwaran, at ipinaliliwanag ng Hebreo na si Hesus ay naglilingkod ngayon sa santuwaryo sa langit. Sa Araw ng Pagtubos, naharap ang Israel sa paglilinis, pananagutan, at panunumbalik ng pakikisama sa Diyos. Tumutulong ang huwarang ito upang maunawaan kung bakit maaaring banggitin ng Kasulatan kapuwa ang natapos na sakripisyo ni Cristo at ang patuloy Niyang gawain bilang Dakilang Saserdote. Ang gawain ni Hesus ang sentro ng turo, hindi ang pagkabighani sa isang petsa.

gtk_connections.title: Maingat na sundan ang pagkukuwenta
gtk_connections.insight: Iniuugnay ng pag-aaral ang 2,300 makahulang gabi at umaga ni Daniel sa propesiya ng pitumpung linggo. Sa paggamit ng simulaing isang araw para sa isang taon at sa panimulang petsang 457 BC, humahantong sa 1844 ang mas mahabang panahon. Ang pag-uugnay ng dalawang kabanata, ang simulaing makahulugan ang panahon, at ang makasaysayang panimulang punto ay mga hakbang sa pagpapakahulugan. Kailangang malinaw itong ipaliwanag upang masuri mismo ng mga mag-aaral ang mga talata sa Biblia at ang pangangatwiran. Huwag ipagkamaling ang mga hakbang na ito ay petsang tuwirang nakasulat sa Biblia.

gtk_questions.question: Talata ba sa Biblia ang 1844?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Isa itong taong nakuwenta mula sa isang partikular na pagbasa ng mga panahong makahula sa Daniel. Dapat bukas sa pagsusuri ang mga talata at pangangatwirang pinagbabatayan nito.

gtk_questions.question: Ibig ba nitong sabihin na noong 1844 lamang nagsimulang magpatawad si Hesus?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Hindi ipinagpaliban sa petsang iyon ang nagliligtas na sakripisyo at pamamagitan ni Cristo. Ang takdang panahon ay nauunawaan bilang isang natatanging huling yugto ng Kaniyang ministeryo sa langit.

gtk_questions.question: Paano kung napakakumplikado nito para sa akin?
gtk_questions.answer: Nauunawaan iyon. Balikan muna ang mga pag-aaral tungkol sa santuwaryo at Daniel 9. Hindi kailangang madaliing lampasan ang mga tanong.

items.gtk_lead: Ano ang sinasabi ng Apocalipsis tungkol sa kapangyarihan at kalayaan?
items.gtk_principle: Sinusuri ang ikalawang hayop sa Apocalipsis bilang sagisag ng isang umuusbong na kapangyarihang sa dakong huli ay susuporta sa sapilitang pagsamba. Ang pangunahing espirituwal na usapin ay kalayaan ng budhi.

gtk_connections.title: Basahin ang ikalawang hayop ayon sa kabuuan ng kabanata
gtk_connections.insight: Ipinakikilala ang ikalawang hayop kaugnay ng unang hayop mula sa dagat. Umaahon ito mula sa lupa, may dalawang sungay na gaya ng kordero, at nagsasalitang gaya ng dragon. Mahalaga ang pagkakaibang ito: ang panlabas na anyong maamo ay hindi kapareho ng tunay na pagtataguyod ng kalayaan. Inilalarawan din ng pangitain ang pamimilit sa budhi at pagsamba. Higit na malawak ang babala kaysa sa pagkakakilanlan ng iisang bansa: hindi kailanman dapat ipataw ang paniniwalang panrelihiyon sa pamamagitan ng puwersa.

gtk_connections.title: Paano binubuo ang pagkakakilanlan
gtk_connections.insight: Iniuugnay ng orihinal na pag-aaral ang paglitaw, heograpiya, at sumunod na impluwensiya ng hayop sa pag-angat ng Estados Unidos. Upang sundan ang pangangatwiran, ihiwalay ang mga sagisag at pagkakasunod ng panahon: ang dagat ay kaugnay ng mga bayan, nagpapahiwatig ang lupa ng naiibang kapaligiran, at nagiging tanyag ang ikalawang kapangyarihan habang ang una ay dumaranas ng pagkabihag. Ginagamit ang mga palatandaang ito sa makasaysayang pagkakakilanlan; hindi tahasang pinapangalanan ng talata ang isang makabagong bansa. Higit na kapaki-pakinabang ang maingat na pagpapaliwanag ng katibayan kaysa sa paglalahad ng konklusyon nang hindi ipinakikita ang mga hakbang.

gtk_connections.title: Ang kalayaan ay kaloob na dapat pangalagaan
gtk_connections.insight: Sa Daniel, tumangging yumukod ang mga tapat na tao nang mag-utos ang isang hari ng pagsamba. Sa Mga Gawa, sumagot ang mga apostol na dapat nilang sundin ang Diyos kaysa sa mga taong may awtoridad nang utusan silang itigil ang pagpapatotoo. May mga lehitimong tungkuling pampubliko ang karamihan sa mga pamahalaan; tumutukoy ang mga kuwentong ito sa sandaling inaangkin ng kapangyarihan ang awtoridad sa pagsamba at budhi ng isang tao. Maaaring magsama ang magalang na pagkamamamayan at katapatan sa Diyos hanggang sa magkaroon ng tunay na pagsasalungatan.

gtk_questions.question: Ibig ba nitong sabihing masasama ang lahat ng tao sa Amerika?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Ang propesiya tungkol sa mga institusyon at pagpili ay hindi paghatol sa bawat mamamayan.

gtk_questions.question: Katuparan ba ng propesiya ang bawat balitang pampolitika?
gtk_questions.answer: Hindi. Iwasan ang mga nakagugulat ngunit walang-batayang hula. Maingat na suriin ang mga pahayag at ihiwalay ang simulain sa Biblia mula sa haka-hakang ulo ng balita.

gtk_questions.question: Ano ang dapat kong gawin sa babalang ito?
gtk_questions.answer: Isabuhay at ipagtanggol ang kalayaan ng budhi, tapat na sundin si Hesus, at pakitunguhan ang iba nang may paggalang.

items.gtk_lead: How do sanctuary symbols connect worship and God’s law?
items.gtk_principle: The colours and materials surrounding God’s law are used in this study as visual reminders of His holiness. We must distinguish what Scripture states from an illustration drawn from it.

gtk_connections.title: Why this unusual lesson matters
gtk_connections.insight: This study uses the imagery of stone, colour and the sanctuary to draw attention to the Ten Commandments and their connection with God’s rule. Scripture explicitly says that God gave Moses stone tablets written by His finger. It also describes a sapphire-like pavement in the vision of His glory. The suggestion that the tablets themselves were made of blue sapphire is a connection, not something Exodus states plainly. We should appreciate the illustration without treating the colour of the tablets as a test of faith.

gtk_connections.title: The law belongs near mercy
gtk_connections.insight: The tablets were placed inside the ark, beneath the mercy seat. The arrangement teaches an important principle: God’s moral government and His mercy are not opposites. He does not change the definition of goodness in order to forgive people who break His law. Instead, the sanctuary points to a way for sinners to return to Him. This is why the earlier lessons on grace and the sanctuary are essential before discussing prophetic attacks on God’s commandments.

gtk_connections.title: Symbolism must be tested by Scripture
gtk_connections.insight: The priests’ garments and Israel’s garments included colours with symbolic reminders. Revelation uses striking clothing imagery for a corrupt religious power. The source lesson compares these descriptions as an illustration of lost faithfulness to God’s law. Such visual parallels can help us remember a principle, but an absent colour is not an explicit biblical definition of a prophecy. Read the passages as they stand before drawing the connection.

gtk_questions.question: Were the Ten Commandments written on blue sapphire?
gtk_questions.answer: The Bible says they were written on stone tablets. The exact material and colour are not explicitly given in those passages.

gtk_questions.question: Do colours automatically identify a church?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Symbols need their full context. Similar colours alone do not prove an interpretation.

gtk_questions.question: Why include this lesson at all?
gtk_questions.answer: It connects sanctuary imagery, God’s law and the question of worship. It is best approached after the foundational lessons with care about what Scripture actually says.

items.gtk_practice: Read Exodus 24 and Numbers 15. Make two columns headed “What the text says” and “What the illustration suggests”. Keep them separate.

items.gtk_lead: Could one day each week be a gift from God?
items.gtk_principle: The seventh-day Sabbath is God’s gift of time to remember creation, celebrate redemption and enjoy relationship with Him.

gtk_connections.title: Rest begins with creation
gtk_connections.insight: Before there was a nation of Israel or a law given at Sinai, Genesis says God rested, blessed and sanctified the seventh day. He did not rest from exhaustion; He established a gift of time for His creatures. The fourth commandment later directs people back to that creation story. Sabbath rest reminds us that life is more than work, production and achievement. We belong to our Creator, not to the endless demands of our schedules.

gtk_connections.title: A reminder of freedom and care
gtk_connections.insight: When Moses repeated the commandment, he connected Sabbath with deliverance from slavery. Rest was not a privilege reserved for those who could afford to stop working; servants and foreigners were included. This gives the Sabbath a social meaning: other people need rest and dignity too. Isaiah describes it as a delight. A day centred on God is not meant to be a burden of anxious rules but a weekly opportunity for worship, mercy, refreshment and love.

gtk_connections.title: Jesus shows how to keep it
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus attended worship on the Sabbath and healed people on that day. When religious leaders turned the day into an occasion for condemnation, He showed its true purpose. Doing good, relieving suffering and honouring God fit the spirit of the Sabbath. This keeps us from two extremes: treating the day as meaningless and turning it into a list of man-made restrictions. The Lord of the Sabbath teaches us how rest and compassion belong together.

gtk_questions.question: Why Saturday rather than Sunday?
gtk_questions.answer: The Sabbath command identifies the seventh day. The day identified by the fourth commandment corresponds to Saturday. The Bible does not give a command transferring the Sabbath’s holiness to Sunday.

gtk_questions.question: Can I do good for someone on Sabbath?
gtk_questions.answer: Yes. Jesus showed that mercy and doing good are appropriate on Sabbath.

gtk_questions.question: Does keeping Sabbath save me?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Salvation is by grace through faith. Sabbath observance is a response of love and trust, not a purchase price for heaven.

items.gtk_practice: Plan one Sabbath beginning Friday sunset: worship, rest, time with others and an act of kindness. Write how each part reflects the Creator’s love.

items.gtk_lead: What will Jesus’ return be like?
items.gtk_principle: The return of Jesus is a personal, visible and hopeful event, not merely a symbol for human progress or a secret happening.

gtk_connections.title: A promise made by Jesus
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus comforts His followers by promising to return and receive them to Himself. The angels at His ascension say that the same Jesus who was taken into heaven will come again. The hope of His return is therefore not built on a prediction about political events alone. It begins with His personal promise to people He loves. Christians need not know the date to know the One who is coming.

gtk_connections.title: Visible, glorious and unmistakable
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus warned that some would claim He had returned secretly or could be found in a special hidden place. Instead, He described His coming as public and unmistakable, like lightning visible across the sky. Revelation says every eye will see Him. This matters when a persuasive speaker claims special access to Christ. We can compare their claim with Scripture rather than being led by fear, spectacular signs or a confident personality.

gtk_connections.title: Resurrection and reunion
gtk_connections.insight: Paul gives comfort to believers grieving loved ones: the dead in Christ will rise, and those who belong to Jesus will be with Him. The second coming is not merely an announcement that the world is ending. It is the promised reunion and the defeat of death. This teaching also connects with the later lessons about the state of the dead and the millennium, giving mourners hope grounded in Jesus’ resurrection.

gtk_questions.question: Should I fear that I will miss Jesus’ return?
gtk_questions.answer: The passages portray a visible, unmistakable event. The invitation is to trust Him, not chase secret signs.

gtk_questions.question: Can someone calculate the exact date?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Jesus warned against claiming to know the day or hour.

gtk_questions.question: What if life is difficult now?
gtk_questions.answer: The return of Christ promises an end to separation, grief and the brokenness we experience.

items.gtk_practice: Read 1 Thessalonians 4:13–18. Write a message of comfort to someone grieving, using only the promises found in the passage.

items.gtk_lead: What are we, and what happens when we die?
items.gtk_principle: The Bible describes human life as a gift from God and death as an unconscious sleep until the resurrection. Immortality comes through Christ, not as an independent possession.

gtk_connections.title: What makes a human being alive?
gtk_connections.insight: Genesis describes God forming the man from dust and breathing life into him; the man becomes a living being. This study understands a person as a whole created life rather than an immortal soul temporarily imprisoned in a body. Death reverses the gift of life: the body returns to dust and the life-giving breath belongs to God. That is not a statement that a person becomes less valuable after death. It emphasises our complete dependence on the Creator.

gtk_connections.title: What do the dead know?
gtk_connections.insight: These passages describe death as a condition in which ordinary thought, work and participation in earthly affairs cease. Other passages use language about spirits and souls, so careful readers should consider their contexts rather than collecting isolated phrases. The teaching developed here is that human beings do not possess independent, natural immortality. Life is the gift of God, and the Bible directs the bereaved toward a future resurrection.

gtk_connections.title: Jesus called death a sleep
gtk_connections.insight: When Lazarus died, Jesus first used the image of sleep, then explained clearly that His friend was dead. Sleep is a fitting picture because someone sleeping does not experience the passage of time as those awake do, and because awakening points toward resurrection. Jesus did not tell Martha to put her trust in disembodied life. He called Himself the resurrection and the life. In grief, hope rests upon the power and promise of Christ.

gtk_questions.question: Is my loved one watching over me from heaven?
gtk_questions.answer: Ecclesiastes 9:5 and John 11 describe death as an unconscious rest until resurrection. Grief deserves tenderness rather than arguments.

gtk_questions.question: Will I see people I love again?
gtk_questions.answer: The Bible holds out the promise of resurrection in Christ. It is a reason for hope even while we mourn.

gtk_questions.question: What is the difference between a soul and a person?
gtk_questions.answer: In Genesis 2:7, humanity becomes a living being when God gives the breath of life. The original study reads “soul” in this integrated sense.

items.gtk_practice: Draw the sequence in Genesis 2:7 and the resurrection promise in 1 Corinthians 15. Use the passages to explain what death and hope mean in your own words.

items.gtk_lead: What does it mean to give God our allegiance?
items.gtk_principle: The final conflict in Revelation concerns worship and allegiance. A mark of loyalty cannot be understood apart from the contrasting call to worship the Creator and follow Jesus.

gtk_connections.title: Read the warning together with the good news
gtk_connections.insight: The mark of the beast appears in a prophecy about authority, worship and pressure to conform. Immediately beside the warning, Revelation describes the everlasting gospel and a call to worship the Creator. That order matters. A study about the mark that leaves people terrified but never points them to Jesus has missed the centre of the passage. God is not trying to trap sincere people with an obscure technicality; He is calling for informed faithfulness.

gtk_connections.title: Worship reaches the heart and the life
gtk_connections.insight: The earlier lessons have shown that God’s law expresses His character and that the Spirit writes it on hearts. Revelation’s picture of forehead and hand communicates loyalty in thought and action. The conflict concerns whether people will follow the Creator or give ultimate authority to a competing system. The Sabbath has an important place in the argument because the fourth commandment identifies God as Creator. The reasoning should be studied as a connected Bible argument rather than a one-sentence slogan.

gtk_connections.title: Coercion is the sign of counterfeit religion
gtk_connections.insight: In Daniel 3, a ruler commanded everyone to worship an image under threat of punishment. Faithful people refused because conscience belongs to God. Revelation uses similar themes of an image, worship and penalties. This is why religious liberty is not a side issue. Pressure to buy, sell or remain socially secure becomes dangerous when it is used to force worship. We can disagree seriously about teaching while continuing to protect every person’s freedom of conscience.

gtk_questions.question: Does a Sunday-worshipping Christian already have the mark?
gtk_questions.answer: No. The prophecy is understood to concern a future, informed crisis of conscience and coercion. We cannot judge another person’s heart.

gtk_questions.question: Is the mark just a barcode or computer chip?
gtk_questions.answer: The source study understands it primarily in terms of worship, authority and allegiance, not a particular consumer technology.

gtk_questions.question: What should I focus on?
gtk_questions.answer: Know Jesus, take Scripture seriously, respect others’ conscience and refuse fear-driven speculation.

items.gtk_practice: Read Revelation 13 and 14 together. Mark every reference to worship, faith, commandments, coercion and the gospel. Summarise the choice being described.

items.gtk_lead: What happens during the thousand years?
items.gtk_principle: Revelation presents a thousand-year period after Christ’s return in which the justice of God is made clear and sin moves toward its final end.

gtk_connections.title: The resurrection gives the timeline its starting point
gtk_connections.insight: The millennium means a thousand-year period described in Revelation 20. To understand it, begin with Jesus’ return and the resurrection of believers. Revelation distinguishes the first resurrection from the later events. A clear sequence helps prevent confusion: Christ returns, His people share in His victory, the thousand years pass, and the final judgment and restoration follow. The passage gives an outline, not a detailed diary of every year.

gtk_connections.title: What does binding Satan mean?
gtk_connections.insight: Revelation uses symbolic language about an angel, a chain and an abyss. The original study connects Satan’s binding with the desolation of the earth and the absence of people he can deceive during that period. A literal iron chain is not the point: Satan’s opportunities for deception are restrained. Reading the symbol beside the wider biblical sequence is more helpful than imagining details the chapter does not supply.

gtk_connections.title: God makes His judgments understandable
gtk_connections.insight: Revelation speaks of judgment given to God’s people. The picture suggests that the redeemed are not kept in the dark about God’s dealings with evil. Questions about suffering, choices and justice will not be dismissed as unimportant. God’s purpose is not merely to announce that He is right but to demonstrate the goodness and fairness of His decisions. This continues the lesson on judgment and the great controversy.

gtk_questions.question: Do I need to memorise every event in order?
gtk_questions.answer: No. First understand the big picture: Christ returns, God’s justice is made clear and evil finally ends.

gtk_questions.question: Why allow a period of review?
gtk_questions.answer: The review reveals that God’s judgments are fair rather than arbitrary.

gtk_questions.question: What is the ultimate point?
gtk_questions.answer: A universe free from sin, with life and fellowship restored.

items.gtk_practice: Make a simple sequence: Christ returns; resurrection; thousand years; final judgment; new earth. Put biblical references beside each stage.

items.gtk_lead: Would a loving God torment people forever?
items.gtk_principle: God’s final judgment is real and just, but the study teaches that the wicked will finally perish rather than remain alive in endless torture. The picture of God must be consistent with His love and justice.

gtk_connections.title: Begin with the God revealed in Jesus
gtk_connections.insight: Questions about hell often arise when someone has imagined a God who takes pleasure in the endless suffering of people. The study begins elsewhere: Scripture describes God as love, giving His Son to save rather than to condemn the world. Whatever we conclude about the final destruction of evil must be understood alongside that revelation of His character. We cannot simply ignore passages about judgment, but neither should we interpret them in ways that make God delight in cruelty.

gtk_connections.title: The contrast is life and death
gtk_connections.insight: Paul contrasts the wages of sin—death—with God’s gift of eternal life. Jesus speaks of the destruction of both body and soul. These passages are central to the conclusion that the lost do not receive the gift of endless conscious life in suffering; they face final destruction. The seriousness of that end should never be made trivial. It represents an irreversible loss, and the loving God of Scripture calls people away from it.

gtk_connections.title: Everlasting results are not the same as endless burning
gtk_connections.insight: Jude describes Sodom as an example of eternal fire, even though the city is not visibly burning today. That suggests fire whose judgment is final. Malachi pictures wickedness consumed, not preserved without end. Revelation’s symbolic language can be difficult and deserves careful study in its wider setting. We should distinguish between an everlasting outcome and an unending process rather than assuming the two mean the same thing.

gtk_questions.question: Does the Bible teach endless conscious torture?
gtk_questions.answer: No. The passages contrast the gift of immortality with the final destruction of the wicked, not eternal conscious torment.

gtk_questions.question: Does that mean wrong actions do not matter?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Judgement remains serious. The difference concerns the nature and duration of final punishment.

gtk_questions.question: How should I talk about this with someone frightened of hell?
gtk_questions.answer: Begin with God’s love and Jesus’ promise of life. Take their fear seriously, avoid threats and study Scripture together gently.

items.gtk_practice: Compare Romans 6:23, Malachi 4:1–3 and Revelation 21:4. Describe the contrast between eternal life and the final end of sin.

items.gtk_lead: Does God still guide His people?
items.gtk_principle: The Holy Spirit gives gifts for the building up of God’s people, including prophecy. A genuine claim to speak for God must be tested by Scripture and by its fruits.

gtk_connections.title: God’s gifts are for service
gtk_connections.insight: The Holy Spirit equips believers in different ways for the good of the whole church. A genuine gift does not exist to make one person famous or to create unquestionable control over others. Prophetic ministry calls people toward truth, encouragement, correction and faithfulness to God. As with any teaching ministry, its value is measured in service to Christ and His people.

gtk_connections.title: God has spoken through human messengers
gtk_connections.insight: The Bible contains many examples of God sending messages through prophets, and Joel promises that prophetic activity would not be confined to ancient times. Hebrews also places Jesus at the centre of God’s revelation. This means later spiritual claims must never replace the gospel or become a new authority higher than Scripture. The Spirit who inspired Scripture will not contradict its clear message about Christ.

gtk_connections.title: Every claim must be tested
gtk_connections.insight: Scripture instructs believers not to despise prophecy and not to accept every claimed spirit. Both warnings matter. A person may be sincere and mistaken, persuasive and wrong, or faithful and worth hearing. Test the content by the Bible, the confession of Jesus, the fruit produced and the accuracy of genuine predictive claims. Where an assertion cannot be verified, say so. Testing is an act of faithfulness, not disrespect.

gtk_questions.question: Do I need to read Ellen White before reading the Bible?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Begin with Scripture. Her writings may be used as supporting reading, but they should point you toward Jesus and the Bible.

gtk_questions.question: Can someone claim God told them something and therefore never be questioned?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Scripture calls us to test such claims. Humility and accountability are important.

gtk_questions.question: How can I check a quote attributed to Ellen White?
gtk_questions.answer: Look it up in EGW Writings, read the surrounding paragraph and verify the book and page rather than sharing unsourced snippets.

items.gtk_practice: Make a checklist from Isaiah 8:20, Matthew 7:15–20 and 1 John 4:1–3 for evaluating spiritual claims with humility and care.

items.gtk_lead: How can I recognise a faithful Christian community?
items.gtk_principle: God calls people to remain faithful to Jesus and His word in a world of confusion. The focus is a mission of truth, love, obedience and witness, never a claim of personal superiority.

gtk_connections.title: God has always called people to faithfulness
gtk_connections.insight: When Elijah thought he was the only faithful person remaining, God revealed that others had not bowed to false worship. The word remnant describes people preserved by God’s grace when many turn away. It must not become a source of boasting. The biblical emphasis is God’s faithfulness, not the superiority of those who recognise themselves as part of His people.

gtk_connections.title: Jesus seeks one flock
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus compared Himself to a good shepherd who gathers sheep. He also prayed for unity among His followers. Christian unity is not created by merely avoiding difficult questions, nor by forcing agreement. It develops as people hear His voice, love one another and respond to revealed truth. The practical question is whether a community makes Jesus clearer and helps people follow Him in sincerity.

gtk_connections.title: Revelation describes the last-day people of God
gtk_connections.insight: The book of Revelation pictures a people who hold to God’s commandments and the faith of Jesus while proclaiming an urgent message about the Creator, judgment and true worship. The lesson traces the connection between gospel faith, obedience and mission. These are characteristics to take seriously, not excuses for contempt toward Christians of other communities. God knows people in every place, and His call is to all who will hear Him.

gtk_questions.question: Does joining one denomination automatically save me?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Salvation is through Christ, not a membership record. A healthy church helps people grow in faith and love.

gtk_questions.question: Are sincere Christians found in other churches?
gtk_questions.answer: Yes. Jesus knows His sheep, including those who follow Him sincerely in different congregations.

gtk_questions.question: What should I look for in a church?
gtk_questions.answer: Faithfulness to Scripture, a Christ-centred message, humility, genuine care, freedom of conscience and practical service.

items.gtk_practice: Write how you would explain a “faithful remnant” to a friend without making them feel unwelcome. Include Revelation 14:6 and John 10:16.

items.gtk_lead: How should faith influence our choices and appearance?
items.gtk_principle: Following Jesus changes priorities, appearance and habits. The study especially examines adornment, modesty and humility, asking what helps or distracts from a Christ-centred life.

gtk_connections.title: The question is the heart, not appearances alone
gtk_connections.insight: God looks at the heart, and Jesus warned that treasures can capture our loyalty. Questions about dress, jewellery, possessions and entertainment are therefore more than arguments about lists. We should ask whether something encourages pride, waste, dishonesty, lust, exclusion or an unhealthy hunger for attention. The same outward choice can involve different motives, so discussions should be thoughtful and avoid judging someone’s worth by appearance.

gtk_connections.title: Beauty is not inherently evil
gtk_connections.insight: Scripture can use jewellery, rich materials and beauty positively. It can also warn of decoration used for self-glory and spiritual unfaithfulness. The source study makes this contrast in order to question when adornment moves from appreciation to self-exaltation. That means we should not claim every ornament is automatically sinful, while also recognising that outward display can become an idol. Simplicity can be a valuable expression of humility and wise stewardship.

gtk_connections.title: A renewed life changes priorities
gtk_connections.insight: Paul calls for transformation through the renewing of the mind. Peter directs attention to the lasting beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit. These teachings concern priorities: how much time, money and attention are spent cultivating an image, and how much is invested in kindness, integrity and service? The Spirit works with conscience over time, helping believers reconsider habits without turning growth into a competition.

gtk_questions.question: Is every piece of jewellery automatically sinful?
gtk_questions.answer: The original study asks this question and notes biblical examples of ornamentation. It argues for caution about pride and display rather than assuming every instance has the same meaning.

gtk_questions.question: How do I know whether something is appropriate?
gtk_questions.answer: Ask what motivates you, what it communicates, whether it is responsible, and whether it honours God and others. Seek wisdom without judging appearances.

gtk_questions.question: Does God only accept me if I dress a certain way?
gtk_questions.answer: No. God loves people before their outward habits change. Growth in Christian character should not become shame or social pressure.

items.gtk_practice: Choose one decision about clothes, spending, entertainment or social media. Ask: Does this encourage humility, love and a clear conscience before God?

items.gtk_lead: How do I talk to a God I cannot see?
items.gtk_principle: Prayer is a real relationship with our heavenly Father. It includes worship, confession, asking, listening and trust rather than a formula for controlling outcomes.

gtk_connections.title: Jesus treated prayer as essential
gtk_connections.insight: Even with many people wanting His attention, Jesus made space for prayer, sometimes before major decisions. Prayer is not an emergency device reserved for desperate moments. It is a relationship in which we turn toward our Father, listen to Scripture, express gratitude and seek guidance. Beginners need not use impressive words. They can start by telling God the truth about the day and asking for wisdom.

gtk_connections.title: The Lord’s Prayer teaches priorities
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus taught His followers to pray for God’s name to be honoured, His kingdom to come and His will to be done. Only then does the prayer turn to daily bread, forgiveness and protection. These are not magic words that must be repeated a certain number of times. They are a pattern for putting trust, dependence and relationships before selfish demands. The prayer includes both personal needs and responsibility to forgive others.

gtk_connections.title: Confidence is different from controlling God
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus invites us to ask, seek and knock because God is a loving Father. But prayer is not a promise that God must obey our timetable or deliver anything we demand. Scripture calls us to pray according to His will, to examine selfish motives and to trust His wisdom. A painful unanswered prayer does not prove that God has stopped loving us. Sometimes a faithful prayer is simply, “Help me to trust You while I wait.”

gtk_questions.question: What if I do not know the right words?
gtk_questions.answer: Start simply: “God, I am here. I need help.” Jesus taught a model prayer, not a complicated formula.

gtk_questions.question: What if my prayer seems unanswered?
gtk_questions.answer: That can be painful. The Bible encourages persistent trust but does not promise every outcome we want. Seek support from people who care and keep speaking honestly to God.

gtk_questions.question: Can I pray when I have done something wrong?
gtk_questions.answer: Yes. Come humbly and honestly. Prayer is especially important when we need forgiveness and a new start.

items.gtk_practice: Use the Lord’s Prayer as a guide. Write one sentence of praise, one request for provision, one confession, and one prayer for another person.

items.gtk_lead: Does God care about my everyday wellbeing?
items.gtk_principle: Our bodies and minds are gifts to be cared for. God’s concern for health includes food, rest, temperance, service and hope—not judgment of people who become ill.

gtk_connections.title: God cares about the whole person
gtk_connections.insight: Life with God touches the mind, body, relationships and spirit. Jesus healed people, fed the hungry and cared about their suffering. Health principles should therefore be presented as an invitation to care for God’s gifts rather than a claim that people with illness have weak faith. Bodies change, some conditions are inherited and many causes of suffering are outside a person’s control. Compassion belongs at the centre of a biblical approach to wellbeing.

gtk_connections.title: Stewardship begins with everyday choices
gtk_connections.insight: Paul speaks of the believer’s body as belonging to God and being a place where the Spirit is honoured. That gives meaning to eating, activity, sleep and avoiding harmful substances. The source study uses the memory guide NEWSTART—nutrition, exercise, water, sunlight, temperance, air, rest and trust in God—to organise practical habits. It is a helpful reminder, not a substitute for individual medical advice.

gtk_connections.title: Self-control is a gift for service
gtk_connections.insight: The Bible warns against intoxication and celebrates self-control. The purpose of temperance is to keep our judgment clear, protect relationships and care responsibly for life. It is not a reason to shame someone struggling with addiction. Such struggles can require medical, psychological, community and spiritual support. A wise believer combines prayer with sensible help and learns to encourage rather than condemn.

gtk_questions.question: If I become sick, have I failed spiritually?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Illness has many causes and must not be used as a measure of faith. Offer compassion and appropriate care.

gtk_questions.question: Must everyone follow an identical diet?
gtk_questions.answer: The source encourages a healthful diet and discusses nutrition. A plant-centred way of eating may be helpful, but personal medical needs and wise practical choices matter.

gtk_questions.question: Is this medical advice?
gtk_questions.answer: No. It is a faith-and-wellbeing lesson, not a diagnosis or substitute for guidance from qualified clinicians.

items.gtk_practice: Choose one sustainable health habit to improve this week. Make a realistic plan and remember that illness or disability is never evidence of spiritual failure.

items.gtk_lead: What does baptism mean, and am I ready?
items.gtk_principle: Baptism is the public expression of trusting Jesus, turning from the old life and beginning a new life with Him. It is a response to grace, not a payment for salvation.

gtk_connections.title: Jesus gave the example
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus was baptised and later commanded His followers to make disciples and baptise them. Baptism is therefore more than joining a social group or performing a family tradition. It is a public response to Christ. Jesus’ baptism also reminds us that baptism points beyond the person carrying it out; it belongs to God’s saving work and the new relationship He offers.

gtk_connections.title: Repentance means a change of direction
gtk_connections.insight: When listeners asked Peter what to do, he called them to repentance and baptism. Repentance includes recognising wrong, changing our mind and turning toward God. It is not merely feeling embarrassed after being caught. Jesus spoke of the new birth as a work of the Spirit. Baptism expresses that inward change but cannot mechanically create it. We respond to grace with faith, confession and a willingness to follow.

gtk_connections.title: Immersion pictures death and new life
gtk_connections.insight: Paul explains baptism as being buried with Christ and raised to walk in newness of life. Going down into and rising from the water makes the picture visible. The old direction of life is surrendered; a new life of trusting Jesus begins. This does not mean a baptised person will never fail. It means they now belong to Christ and seek His power to leave sin behind.

gtk_questions.question: Do I have to know every Bible teaching first?
gtk_questions.answer: Baptism should be thoughtful and informed, but no one understands everything. Speak with a pastor or mentor about the core beliefs and questions that matter to you.

gtk_questions.question: What if I still struggle with old habits?
gtk_questions.answer: Baptism does not promise a struggle-free life. It marks a commitment to trust Christ and grow with His help.

gtk_questions.question: Why immersion?
gtk_questions.answer: The original study connects immersion with the picture of burial and resurrection in Romans 6 and the baptisms described in Acts.

items.gtk_practice: Read Romans 6:1–11. Write what you are leaving behind, what new life means to you and any questions you would want answered before baptism.

items.gtk_lead: Who are the Father, Son and Holy Spirit?
items.gtk_principle: The Bible reveals one God as Father, Son and Holy Spirit. Their perfect unity and love are the foundation of how God makes Himself known.

gtk_connections.title: The Bible declares one God
gtk_connections.insight: Israel’s confession that the Lord is one is foundational. Christians do not worship three competing gods. When the Bible also speaks about Father, Son and Holy Spirit, the task is to understand those passages without denying the oneness of God. Some things about God exceed our full understanding, but Scripture tells us enough to know His character, receive His salvation and worship Him faithfully.

gtk_connections.title: The Son shares the divine identity
gtk_connections.insight: John describes the Word as with God and as God, and says the Word became flesh. Jesus is not merely a helpful religious teacher or the first creature God made. The Gospels describe Him receiving worship, revealing the Father and acting with divine authority. His full deity matters for salvation: in Christ, God Himself has come near to rescue humanity.

gtk_connections.title: The Spirit is more than an impersonal power
gtk_connections.insight: Jesus promised another Helper who would teach and remind His followers of His words. Acts speaks of lying to the Holy Spirit as lying to God. The Spirit is not simply an electrical force or a feeling. He works personally, leading people into truth and forming Christlike lives. We need not understand every mystery of divine existence before responding to His guidance.

gtk_questions.question: Are Christians worshipping three gods?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Scripture reveals one God as Father, Son and Holy Spirit.

gtk_questions.question: Is Jesus less than God?
gtk_questions.answer: Jesus is fully divine and eternal, while also truly becoming human for our salvation.

gtk_questions.question: Must I understand every detail to begin faith?
gtk_questions.answer: No. You do not need to understand every mystery or settle every theological term before you begin trusting Jesus. Scripture warns against rejecting the Son (1 John 2:23) and speaks seriously about resisting the Spirit, but this study is not a test for condemning sincere learners. Keep seeking God through Jesus with humility.

items.gtk_practice: Read John 14–16 over several days. Make three lists of what Scripture says the Father, Son and Spirit do.

items.gtk_lead: What does faith have to do with money and time?
items.gtk_principle: God owns everything; we are entrusted with life, abilities, time, money and creation. Giving is an act of worship and service rather than a purchase of blessing.

gtk_connections.title: Ownership changes how we view possessions
gtk_connections.insight: The Bible begins with God as Creator. Our time, abilities, money, relationships and physical lives are entrusted to us; we are not their ultimate owners. This does not mean we should despise what we have. It means we can use gifts gratefully rather than letting them rule us. Even ordinary decisions about budgets and schedules can become expressions of worship when they are made with honesty and love.

gtk_connections.title: Giving is a response to grace
gtk_connections.insight: Paul’s teaching about generosity begins with the grace of Jesus, who gave Himself for us. God is interested in willing giving, not coercion or showing off. Christians should be free to ask responsible questions about how offerings are used. Generosity can include financial support, hospitality, service and care for people in difficulty. The heart of stewardship is trust in God and concern for others.

gtk_connections.title: Understand the tithe principle
gtk_connections.insight: The Bible speaks of a tithe, a tenth, set apart for God. The source lesson follows the principle through Abraham, Israel and the stewardship of God’s people. As with every biblical practice, read the original covenant setting before applying it today. The aim is not to purchase blessings with money or make people feel condemned when they are poor. Giving should express gratitude, trust and a desire to support God’s work faithfully.

gtk_questions.question: Will God make me wealthy if I tithe?
gtk_questions.answer: The lesson does not promise a guaranteed financial return. Giving expresses faith and gratitude, not a transaction that obligates God to enrich us.

gtk_questions.question: What if I am struggling to pay necessities?
gtk_questions.answer: God knows your circumstances. Seek wise financial support, act responsibly and speak with a trustworthy church leader about questions rather than responding to pressure.

gtk_questions.question: Does stewardship only mean money?
gtk_questions.answer: No. It also includes time, gifts, caring for people and looking after creation.

items.gtk_practice: Make four columns: time, abilities, money and relationships. In each list one gift, one responsibility and one generous next step.

items.gtk_lead: How can I share my faith without pushing people away?
items.gtk_principle: We share faith by showing the character of Jesus, speaking truthfully, caring for people and respecting their freedom to respond.

gtk_connections.title: Compassion comes before a programme
gtk_connections.insight: When Jesus saw crowds, He recognised people who were weary and lacking guidance. His response was compassion, teaching and practical care. Sharing faith begins with seeing others as people, not as targets or numbers. Before explaining a doctrine, listen to what someone has experienced, what they fear and what they hope for. Kindness is not an advertising technique; it is part of the message about Jesus.

gtk_connections.title: An ordinary testimony is valuable
gtk_connections.insight: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus, Philip invited a friend to come and see, and a healed man told others what God had done for him. None of these examples requires a public platform or specialised training. You can speak naturally about what you have learned and invite someone to investigate the Scriptures with you. It is better to admit that you do not know an answer than to pretend certainty.

gtk_connections.title: The message is Jesus, not ourselves
gtk_connections.insight: Paul was not ashamed of the gospel because its saving power comes from God. Jesus said that when He is lifted up, He will draw people to Himself. Christian witnessing should therefore introduce people to His character, grace, truth and invitation. We do not need to become performers or pressure someone into a decision. Clear Bible teaching and a sincere life are stronger than exaggeration or manipulation.

gtk_questions.question: What if someone says they are not interested?
gtk_questions.answer: Respect their answer. Genuine friendship should not depend on agreement about faith.

gtk_questions.question: Do I have to know every answer?
gtk_questions.answer: No. Be honest when you do not know something, listen well and offer to explore a question together.

gtk_questions.question: What if I am shy?
gtk_questions.answer: Acts of kindness, a brief personal story and patient friendship can be powerful ways to witness.

items.gtk_practice: Think of one person you can support in a practical way. Write an invitation or encouraging message that allows them freedom to decline.
